A '''clone trooper sergeant''' led [[Decoy Squad Five]], an eight-man [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] unit assigned to eliminate any [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who attempted to return to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the wake of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. The sergeant was killed when two [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Infiltration of the Jedi Temple/Legends|infiltrated]] the Jedi Temple.<ref name="Rots" />
